about.title:
More intention.
Less noise.
about.body: RegenAI explores how original recovery-object designs could fit into everyday life. This is a portfolio design study; the collection is not a verified retail offer.
sections: Designed around the everyday
The collection brings together original industrial-design studies, a clear finder and a calm place to explore the forms.
Objects you can explore
Pulse One was modeled in Blender and can be explored interactively in your browser. The render shows a design direction; physical specifications are not yet confirmed.
A work in progress, openly
The six concepts are published to a Shopify development-store channel for testing. Physical stock, fulfillment and real payment are not available.

evidence.title: Clarity comes first.
evidence.body: Good design is no substitute for evidence. Here is what has and has not been established.
sections: Original design studies, without medical claims
The visuals represent original design studies. Physical specifications and performance have not been verified. No medical-device, clinical, review or health-outcome claim is made.
How the finder works
It groups the current concepts by published product type and design category. It does not assess symptoms or provide medical advice.
Before a real launch
Physical product validation, safety documentation, evidence review, approved policies and confirmed merchandise would be required before real orders open.

privacy.title: Your pause is yours.
privacy.body: This page describes the current design-study storefront. It is not a final policy for a future retail business.
sections: Finder answers and design bag

Finder choices stay in page memory while you browse. In the static design preview, the demo bag saves selected concept IDs, options and quantities in this browser's local storage. Neither is a health profile or a real order.
Cart and account boundary

The public preview has no active ordering or customer account. The separate local development-store cart uses a session cookie and sends test cart changes to Shopify only when its sandbox gate is enabled.
Before accounts or real orders
A final privacy notice, seller details and any required consent controls must be reviewed and published before a real customer service opens.

delivery.title: Explore freely.
delivery.body: No physical products are shipped from this design study. Public ordering and real payment are closed.
sections: Illustrative availability
Development-store prices and availability support the interface demonstration. They do not confirm physical stock or a real offer for sale.
Test checkout
A local development-store test checkout may be enabled during verification. It is a sandbox flow and does not place a real fulfillment order.
Before products go on sale
Actual delivery regions and costs, returns and cancellation terms, warranty and product documentation must be supplied and reviewed before retail checkout opens.

terms.title: A design study, clearly.
terms.body: RegenAI currently presents illustrative product concepts for portfolio review and development-store testing.
sections: No real purchase
Public product pages do not accept a real order or payment. A separately enabled local Shopify checkout is for development-store tests only.
What the images and prices mean
Renders, product descriptions and development-store prices show a possible experience. Physical materials, performance, inventory and final commercial pricing have not been verified.
Before retail launch
Seller identity, product evidence, support contact, final terms and applicable consumer disclosures need owner review before real sales begin.

help.title: A few clear answers.
help.body: Here is how to use the current RegenAI concept storefront.
sections: Can I buy these products?
Not through the public site. The six concepts are illustrative, and real ordering remains closed. A local development-store test cart may be used during verification.
What does the finder recommend?
It helps browse design concepts using simple product categories. It is not a diagnosis, treatment recommendation or personal health assessment.
Are the product details verified?
The imagery is an original design study. Physical specifications, performance, stock and shipping details require validation before a retail launch.
Where can I read more?
Use the Evidence and Demo terms pages for the current design-study limits, or browse the journal for the design process.

contact.title: Let’s keep in touch.
contact.body: RegenAI is a portfolio design study. Reach the project owner through his public professional profile; a retail support inbox is not yet available.
